cues.text: Good morning. City House Services. How may I help you?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Good morning. I’d like to arrange to have my house cleaned.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Certainly. I just need to ask a few questions. First, could I take your name?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, it’s Barbara Hill.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Thank you. Next, is your house in London?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, it’s in Kingston in Southwest London.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: OK, Southwest London and... er, what’s the postcode?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: It's SW105.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: And what is the square footage and what rooms will we be cleaning?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: The whole house is 268 square feet, and there is no need to clean all the rooms. I only want to have my bedrooms cleaned.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: OK, how many bedrooms does the house have?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Three bedrooms. Oh no, sorry, we used to have three bedrooms, but we only have two bedrooms now.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Are those single bedrooms or doubles?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Doubles.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Fine, two doubles...
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: There is one more room which needs cleaning. It was used as a bedroom before, and now we have converted it into an office.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: I understand. Three rooms have got to be cleaned, and are all of those rooms upstairs?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes. Then, downstairs we have a kitchen-diner, conservatory, and lounge. The kitchen-diner is quite large and has the usual equipment - cooker with oven, refrigerator, cupboards, and worktops. The conservatory has a lot of plants, but there’s no need to take care of them. The lounge has a leather three- piece suite and a large coffee table.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Thank you. And do you keep any pets?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yeah, I really love keeping them. I’ve got two dogs and three cats.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: OK, then if our staff come over to offer the service, please take your pets away. Have you looked at our services packages?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Yes, I have one in front of me.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Excellent.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Any extra services you need - switching bed linen, working in the garden, cleaning the glass in the conservatory, that kind of thing?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Err... no... err....... actually, replacing the bed linen, yes that would be good
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: No problem. I’ll just make a note of that. How about curtains, mats, and carpets? What would you like us to do with those items?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: The curtains... I'll have to think about that. I think we should have the carpets cleaned really well every quarter. Mats can just be done with the laundry.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Of course. How about clothes? We can have our staff wash and iron them, or we can have them taken to a dry cleaner’s.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Washing and ironing. No, just ironing. That’ll be OK..
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: OK, fine. I know quite a bit about what you want now. I should let you know that we locate on 12 Amyes Road, that’s A-M-Y-E-S.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Em.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: And we work from Monday to Sunday except Tuesday and Wednesday. Could you let me know when is convenient for you?
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Next Friday... err... no, that’s no good. My son invites his friends over in the afternoon that day. Perhaps next Thursday or next Saturday. Let me check, OK, next Thursday.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: When is it convenient for us to come over and provide the service? Is it OK if we come in the morning? Or we may come in the afternoon? It depends on your schedule.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: I'm OK with any time. Just give me a call to let me know you’re coming before you arrive.
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: Sure, we will.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: By the way, how long would it take for the service?
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: We usually work 1-3 hours for house cleaning, and the work will take three hours at most. And of course, if it takes more than three hours, you should pay extra for it.
cues.speaker: AGENT

cues.text: Er... fine
cues.speaker: CUSTOMER

cues.text: So, let me just do some calculations…
cues.speaker: AGENT
